'''Marrok''' was an [[Anooba/Legends|Anooba]] owned by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Embo/Legends|Embo]]. He visited [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] with his master, coming close to [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]]. He and his master were later seen at Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina around the time when [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] and [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] were at [[Raydonia/Legends|Raydonia]]. Sometime later, he was on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] with his master when [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] and [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] leader [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] met with [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. When the confrontation became a skirmish, Marrok gave chase to the three with a small team that included [[Latts Razzi/Legends|Latts Razzi]], [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]] and [[Sugi (bounty hunter)/Legends|Sugi]]. When Sugi and Embo ambushed the trio after they returned, Maul easily got the upper hand again and was about to finish off the Zabrak when Marrok intervened and saved her by attacking Maul. Maul was eventually able to throw off the Anooba. When the bounty hunters retreated, Marrok retrieved his master's damaged hat as they fled the lost battle. Later on the planet of [[Scipio/Legends|Scipio]], Marrok retrieved Embo's hat after Embo attacked [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], and [[Rush Clovis/Legends|Rush Clovis]].

Joe)|Snake Eyes]] and Timber.<ref name="Insider 134">{{InsiderCite|134|Behind and Beyond the Battle Lines}}</ref>
